build_diffusers_wheel: run python setup.py bdist_wheel to build a wheel distribution for the diffusers package
build_diffusers_source: run python setup.py sdist to build a source distribution tarball for the diffusers package
update_deps_table: run python setup.py deps_table_update to regenerate src/diffusers/dependency_versions_table.py from the deps dict
review_deps_list_function: review the deps_list function that resolves package names to their versioned dependency strings
review_depcstableupdatecommand_class: review the DepsTableUpdateCommand class that writes the autogenerated dependency versions table file
